moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: What this instance is called where people see it: the name of the company or of the installation

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The language and formats shown for a person who has chosen none; a person's own locale wins

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The time zone times are shown in for a person who has chosen none; a person's own zone wins, and business dates keep their owners' meaning

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: New-device sign-in window (days)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A sign-in from a client not seen for this many days is reported to the account's owner as a new device

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Group recipient ceiling
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The most recipients one scheduled report or business alert rule may deliver to as a group; an organization's own cap is at most this

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance purpose
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Production, test or development: what the instance is run for
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set instance_purpose in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The locale of a session with no user and no preference above
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_locale in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone the server reads a time with no zone in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_time_zone in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Database time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone times are stored in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set before the first start; changing it later changes the meaning of stored times

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Public host name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The host name links in mail and redirects are made with
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_http_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: HTTPS links
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether links are made with https
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_https_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Largest upload (bytes)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The largest request body the web server accepts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_max_upload in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Telemetry
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether traces, metrics and logs are kept for Monitor
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set telemetry_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart
